decision_rules.name: fusion
decision_rules.text: Keep the candidates among default and k10-w3 that have more wins than losses and zero top-3 losses vs dense-only (paired strict first relevant rank, tune+heldout combined). Choose the best paired W/L among them: most wins minus losses, then fewest losses, then higher strict MRR@50, then listed order. If none qualify, dense-only becomes the default.

decision_rules.name: graph
decision_rules.text: Only the graph variant whose counterpart (dense-only, default or k10-w3) the fusion rule in candidates.yaml chose is considered. Adopt it only if it beats that counterpart on paired W/L (strict first relevant rank) over tune+heldout combined, and no question loses a top-3 rank relative to that counterpart; otherwise the counterpart stays.
